title: Choose the limit price on the support ladder from touch_5 and xret_20|touch
question: For an eligible entry, does choosing the support-ladder level by a model of touch_5 and xret_20|touch beat the current anchor rule and cash on net return at equal capital, after costs, on identical splits? A tuned gradient-boosting baseline runs first; TFT is a challenger only if the baseline passes its gate.

labels.name: touch_5
labels.definition: 1 if the level price is touched (session low <= level) within 5 sessions after t, else 0; UNKNOWN when any of those sessions is unobserved. KR: invalid_ohlc is unobserved; a no_trade session is observed with no print; a window closed by a terminal event with no touch is 0

labels.name: xret_20_given_touch
labels.definition: excess return over the 20 sessions after the touch fill, conditional on touch_5 = 1. KR: benchmark is the equal-weight return of the listing's market over the same sessions. A listing ending inside the window exits at its last membership close if the event was known by the window's end; unknown otherwise. Write-off of residual_after_liquidation_trading and ambiguous is a reported stress.

splits.scheme: expanding walk-forward on common dates per market: train 2015-2018 / validate 2019, adding one year per fold through validate 2022; KR: purge and gap add up in front of every boundary

period.pending: fixed at the freeze of the model that passes its gate; no prospective look in ROB-1441

test.exposure_audit: KR: exposed, not provably untouched (research/kr_boosting/exposure_audit.py: kr-corpus-v1 validation window, underwater spike trim study, D3 primary and calibration). 2023-2024 is diagnostics only and is counted as a look. US and crypto: their own U7 units repeat the audit; the underwater spike trim study already read both through 2024.
test.seal_rule: decisions after the freeze only; window fixed at the freeze and never extended

candidate_policies.description: unchanged policy: D3 L2 anchor (nearest qualifying confluence), tick_floor, D3 rank
frozen: highest 60-session return in the liquid universe: median 20-session traded value >= 100,000,000 KRW; limit at close -0.5%
frozen: lowest 5-session return in the liquid universe: median 20-session traded value >= 100,000,000 KRW; limit at close -0.5%
LightGBM touch and xret heads pick the rung by P(touch) x (xret - round trip), skip if not positive; rests 5 sessions, exits 20 after the fill (U7)
TFT on identical inputs and splits; runs only if gbm-baseline passes its gate (U8)

costs_fills.cost_table: KR: 0.215% per side (D3 FEE_RATE, tax folded in); stress 0.415% per side; cash 0%
fill_models: optimistic touch: low <= P, gap at the open
conservative through: low <= P - 1 tick, gap at the open
volume share: optimistic gate, 10% of session volume
empirical: unavailable, no fitted model in contract v1

tuning_budget.search: fixed sampled grid per family, sha256 e112e9e51cd48cf6c10f5b9577696a3977d46a1741dcd015e214dcaf4054ae76
tuning_budget.notes: KR: configuration for year Y chosen on year Y-1 by model loss; top 3 refit with 3 seeds; top one's seed mean trades. Fit in-fold: label winsor limits, nothing else is fitted.

metrics.primary: net return vs cash at equal capital, after costs, under the conservative fill model
secondary: results under each of the four fill models

stopping_rules: KR gate on the 2019-2022 walk-forward path, conservative end (research/kr_boosting/gate.py): G1 annual net vs cash > 2%; G2 every control beaten by > 2% a year at Holm p <= 0.10, circular block bootstrap, 20-session blocks; G3 ahead of cash and the unchanged policy in >= 3 of 4 years; G4 positive at the optimistic end
if gbm-baseline fails its gate the ML track for this hypothesis stops; tft-challenger does not run
any leakage finding (available_at > t, preprocessing fitted outside the fold, test rows read before freeze) voids the run
the sealed test period is never reopened for this hypothesis after a look
no market-wide claim on a survivor-only universe
